(April 2026 - Present)

● Using office equipment, such as a telephone system, computer, printer, and photocopier.

Starbucks, Oakland CA - Barista
(October 2024 - December 2024)
● Customer service: Greeting customers, taking orders, and providing a positive experience
● Beverage preparation: Making coffee, tea, and specialty drinks to quality standards
● Menu knowledge: Understanding the menu, including seasonal items and promotions, and helping customers choose
● Cash handling: Operating the cash register, processing payments, and maintaining a balanced cash drawer
● Cleanliness: Keeping the work area clean and organized, including equipment, utensils, and the service area
● Team collaboration: Working with team members to ensure smooth operations
● Problem-solving: Addressing customer concerns and complaints promptly and professionally
● Store procedures: Helping with opening or closing the store, cash handling, and safety and security
● Creating a welcoming atmosphere: Anticipating and meeting customer needs, and creating a welcoming environment for customers.

(August 2019 - November 2020)

● Instructing participants on correct form and body alignment for maximum results and injury prevention.
